basic_info.description: Welcome home sunset lovers! Charming and updated Parkside home with surreal ocean views in the coveted Sunset District of The City. Upstairs you will find two bedrooms with west-facing views of Ocean Beach, updated bathroom and a refreshed kitchen. Downstairs consists of a full bedroom, updated bathroom, and new LVP flooring. New exterior paint job and garage door, newer roof. This home sits in a prime location... only a short walk to Ocean Beach/Great Highway Trail, Golden Gate Park, down the street from West Sunset Playground Park and top rated schools such as A.P. Giannini Middle School, St. Ignatius College Prep School, coffee shops, shopping, and just a couple blocks from Sunset Blvd for your commuting needs. Perhaps your vision includes a rooftop and/or upstairs deck...the sky is the limit..If you build it, they will come!
